scope: Six bounded real local GPU requests verifying transport, strict loading and response contracts; not an accuracy, calibration or comparative performance benchmark.

limits.truncation: Reject before any forward pass, including options and instructions

quality_boundary: The Chinese billing example selected billing, but sufficiency and severity differed between checkpoints. Passing the schema does not establish reliable handling or calibrated confidence. No LLM answer repair was used.
timing_boundary: Individual gateway/probe timings, including preparation, health/HTTP and first-use compute where applicable; initial model loading was outside the request. Workloads differ, so these are neither paired speed comparisons nor percentiles.
privacy_boundary: Original inputs and full receipts retained privately; this aggregate omits authentication tokens, connection records and private filesystem paths. Summary consistency is not independent model attestation.
